description: Copper track (not a schematic trace): draw one of a net by hand as ONE change: corners on one layer, or from and to pads. It starts on the net's copper, not a locked part's pad, and touches no other net. The answer lists copper violations. For what autoroute could not route. at places a via by hand instead, as ONE change; its net is that of the copper under it unless net is given.

at.description: A via's centre in mm, instead of a track

layer.description: Needed with points; inner1, inner2 only on 4 layers

points.description: Corners in mm; the first on the net's copper

via.description: Corners between from and to; none: the router finds the path or says what is in the way

name: route_track
